column4: dialect-gated per SUBTEST: a registeredBackends test, so it runs one subtest per dialect and mysql and mssql skip in these PostgreSQL-only jobs while postgres RUNS -- two, not three. Measured by NAME rather than by delta, with CLEAT_TEST_MYSQL and CLEAT_TEST_MSSQL unset: go test ./engine/ -run TestAnInputSurvivesTheColumnOrDoesNot -count=1 -json | grep '"Action":"skip"' reports exactly the /mysql and /mssql arms. The arms have to exist even where they skip for the same reason its sibling TestAWorkflowResultSurvivesTheColumnOrDoesNot needs them: the subject IS the disagreement between dialects. cleat#1022 second half -- a workflow INPUT and a signal payload come back with a different value depending on the backend, and the degradation is MySQL's alone. A postgres-only run is not a smaller version of this test, it is a run that cannot see the thing.
dialect-gated per SUBTEST: same test, same two arms, and the cluster job runs ./engine/... too. Measured by name with only CLEAT_TEST_POSTGRES set. See the test-go/engine line above.
